frame: duct frame: x across the cards, y along the card height (+y = card top edge / bracket tab end), z along the card axis
print_orientation: flange (case face) on the bed; STL z = duct z - inlet_plane_z
layout: split: one mouth and one gasket loop per card; the middle slot lies under the flange web, outside both loops
steepest_air_wall_note: v4: the plenum walls are v4.plenum_wall_deg (peak <= max_wall_angle); the raw face maximum includes the fins' round tops and root fillets, which face up

plenum_wall_deg.note: peak: the steepest air wall from triangle normals (ceiling: faces looking down, the inner skin overhangs; floor: faces looking up, the air widens, an outer skin parallel to it overhangs). section_bounds_peak: the bounding-box slopes, which miss a corner moving in x and y at once

curves.lip_edges: sides and bottom (none on top: slot-screw tips)

wall_thickness.note: plain skin: polar angle within 10 deg of x/y; the rest includes the 45 deg chamfers under the fan-plate corner ears

layer_audit.note: Geometric layer overlap screen, not a physical print test. Small bridge spans may print without supports; material, cooling and speed matter.

summary.rule: tier A (0.2 mm layers): island beyond 45 deg > 0.25 mm2; tier B (0.28 mm slicer layers): island steeper than 60 deg >= 0.002 mm2; floating islands

allowlist.name: gasket groove roof
allowlist.why: 3.0 mm bridge over the foam groove on the case face

allowlist.name: magnet pocket ceiling
allowlist.why: 10.3 mm bridge over each magnet pocket

allowlist.name: flange
allowlist.why: 2.8 mm flange on the rear panel

allowlist.name: flange fillet
allowlist.why: 3.7 mm concave fillet between flange and body

allowlist.name: fan plate
allowlist.why: 2.4 mm fan plate under the 105 mm screw pattern

allowlist.name: fan-plate ear chamfer blocks
allowlist.why: the plate corners outside the round bore rest on 45 deg chamfered blocks that the fan screws thread into (3.4 mm pilots); at >= 16 mm wide the slicer fills them with sparse infill, not solid

allowlist.name: centre fin root
allowlist.why: the 1.2 mm centre fin: its root widens into the flange strip under it (radius >= 2.4 mm)

allowlist.name: rib A fin root
allowlist.why: the 1.2 mm rib A fin: its root widens into the flange strip under it (radius >= 2.4 mm)

allowlist.name: rib B fin root
allowlist.why: the 1.2 mm rib B fin: its root widens into the flange strip under it (radius >= 2.4 mm)
